Name: Cozy Time Day Display
Author: Stardewzki
TagLine: A small quality-of-life mod that adds an optional HUD overlay showing the current time and date.
Description:
# Cozy Time & Day Display

A small quality-of-life mod that adds an optional HUD overlay showing the current time and date. It’s designed to be subtle, readable, and easy to configure, so you can keep important info visible without opening menus.

By default, the display shows the season, day, year, and current time, but every part can be toggled on or off through the config file. You can also move the display to different corners of the screen, adjust its size, or hide it automatically while menus are open.

There are no gameplay changes — this is a purely visual tweak for Stardew Valley.

## Features
- Optional on-screen display for time and date  
- Toggle season, day, year, and time individually  
- Adjustable position, offset, and scale  
- Option to hide while menus are open  
- Lightweight and safe for existing saves  

## Requirements
- SMAPI

## Links
Documentation, notes, and related Stardew Valley references can be found here:  
https://stardew.wiki/

This mod is intended to stay out of the way, be easy to remove, and work reliably alongside other mods.
